title: Another U.S. appellate court goes against Kalshi, building the industry's legal headwinds
summary: Despite a Commodity Futures Trading Commission demand that prediction markets return to operating in all 50 states, federal courts continue to get in the way.
content: A U.S. appellate court has ruled against Kalshi, adding to growing legal challenges for the prediction market industry. Despite a Commodity Futures Trading Commission demand for prediction markets to operate across all 50 states, federal courts continue to create roadblocks for the platform's expansion and operations.
content_ta: Kalshi நிறுவனத்திற்கு எதிராக ஒரு U.S. appellate நீதிமன்றம் தீர்ப்பளித்துள்ளது, இது prediction market துறைக்கு மேலும் சட்ட சிக்கல்களை உருவாக்குகிறது. அனைத்து 50 மாநிலங்களிலும் prediction markets தொடர்ந்து செயல்பட வேண்டும் என்ற Commodity Futures Trading Commission இன் கோரிக்கை இருந்தபோதிலும், இந்த தளத்தின் விரிவாக்கத்திற்கு கூட்டாட்சி நீதிமன்றங்கள் தொடர்ந்து தடைைகளை உருவாக்குகின்றன.

title: Trump administration unveils new center to choke off scam payments
summary: Americans reported more than $17.7 billion in online fraud losses in 2025.
content: The Trump administration has unveiled a new center aimed at choking off scam payments. The initiative comes as online fraud continues to pose a major challenge for consumers, following reports of massive financial losses by Americans totaling more than $17.7 billion.
content_ta: Trump administration மோசடி கட்டணங்களைத் தடுப்பதை நோக்கமாகக் கொண்ட புதிய மையம் ஒன்றை அறிமுகப்படுத்தியுள்ளது. Americans $17.7 பில்லியனுக்கும் அதிகமான ஆன்லைன் மோசடி இழப்புகளைப் புகாரளித்துள்ள நிலையில், இந்த புதிய நடவடிக்கை எடுக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: Fed officials saw October rate hold as a ‘close call,’ minutes show
summary: The latest FOMC minutes suggest greater appetite for higher rates than the Fed’s 10–2 vote indicated, with markets now pricing in a December hike.
content: Recently released Fed minutes revealed that the October interest rate hold was considered a close call by officials. The Federal Open Market Committee discussion indicated a stronger appetite for higher borrowing costs than the initial 10-2 vote suggested. Following the publication of these minutes, financial markets have begun increasingly pricing in the possibility of a rate hike in December.
content_ta: வெளியிடப்பட்ட Fed கூட்டத்தின் குறிப்புகளின்படி, அக்டோபர் வட்டி விகிதத்தை மாற்றாமல் வைத்திருப்பது மிகவும் நெருக்கமான முடிவு என்று அதிகாரிகள் கருதினர். ஆரம்பத்தில் பதிவான 10-2 வாக்கு எண்ணிக்கையை விட, அதிக வட்டி விகிதங்களுக்கு ஆதரவு அதிகம் இருந்ததை இந்த விவாதங்கள் காட்டுகின்றன. இந்த அறிக்கையைத் தொடர்ந்து, டிசம்பர் மாதத்தில் வட்டி உயர்த்தப்படலாம் என்று நிதிச் சந்தைகள் கணிக்கத் தொடங்கியுள்ளன.

title: Standard Chartered, StraitsX, OCBC complete trial of tokenized deposit interoperability
summary: The companies said that unlocking the full potential of 'always-on' tokenized deposits requires interoperability across platforms.
content: Standard Chartered, StraitsX, and OCBC have successfully completed a trial focusing on the interoperability of tokenized deposits. The participating companies noted that unlocking the full potential of these always-on digital financial instruments requires seamless interoperability across different platforms and systems.
content_ta: Standard Chartered, StraitsX மற்றும் OCBC ஆகியவை டோக்கன் செய்யப்பட்ட டெபாசிட்டுகளின் இயங்குதன்மை தொடர்பான சோதனையை வெற்றிகரமாக நிறைவு செய்துள்ளன. எப்போதும் செயல்பாட்டில் இருக்கும் இந்த டிஜிட்டல் நிதி கருவிகளின் முழு திறனையும் வெளிக்கொணர பல்வேறு தளங்கள் முழுவதும் தடையற்ற இயங்குதன்மை தேவை என்று சம்பந்தப்பட்ட நிறுவனங்கள் குறிப்பிட்டுள்ளன.

title: Bitcoin launches Testnet5 and gives miners a real trial of four proposed fixes
summary:
Mining pools can test the blocks their software builds while Bitcoin Core and Sparrow Wallet prepare support.
Read the full story on CryptoSlate
Understand the crypto stories that matter and what to watch next. Get The Catalyst in your inbox
content: Bitcoin has launched Testnet5, providing miners with a real trial of four proposed protocol fixes. This release allows mining pools to test the blocks generated by their software. Meanwhile, Bitcoin Core and Sparrow Wallet are preparing to offer full support for the new testnet environment, helping improve overall network stability and testing procedures.
content_ta: Bitcoin தனது Testnet5-ai அறிமுகப்படுத்தியுள்ளது, இது மைனர்களுக்கு நான்கு முன்மொழியப்பட்ட திருத்தங்களைச் சோதிக்க உண்மையான வாய்ப்பை வழங்குகிறது. மைனிங் பூக்கள் தங்கள் மென்பொருளால் உருவாக்கப்பட்ட பிளாக்குகளை இதன் மூலம் சோதிக்கலாம். இதற்கிடையில், Bitcoin Core மற்றும் Sparrow Wallet ஆகியவை புதிய டெஸ்ட்நெட் சூழலுக்கான ஆதரவைத் தயாரிக்கத் தொடங்கியுள்ளன.

title: Binance Plans Expansion into 5 Asian Markets
summary: Binance plans to reveal details of its upcoming Asian expansion in early 2027.
content: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance has announced plans to expand its operations into five Asian markets. Company representatives stated that specific details regarding this upcoming regional growth strategy will be officially revealed in early 2027. This move represents a significant step for the platform as it seeks to strengthen its presence and increase its user base across the Asian region.
content_ta: கிரிப்டோகரன்சி பரிமாற்ற நிறுவனமான Binance, ஐந்து ஆசிய சந்தைகளில் தனது சேவைகளை விரிவுபடுத்த திட்டமிட்டுள்ளதாக அறிவித்துள்ளது. இந்த வரவிருக்கும் ஆசிய விரிவாக்கம் குறித்த கூடுதல் விவரங்கள் 2027 ஆம் ஆண்டின் தொடக்கத்தில் வெளியிடப்படும் என்று நிறுவனத்தின் பிரதிநிதிகள் தெரிவித்துள்ளனர். ஆசிய பிராந்தியத்தில் தனது இருப்பை வலுப்படுத்தவும், பயனர்களின் எண்ணிக்கையை அதிகரிக்கவும் இந்த நடவடிக்கை உதவும்.

title: What is Ethereum actually for? A judge and Vitalik Buterin both left it open
summary: As a judge acquits the Peraire-Bueno brothers, Bitwise's Hunter Horsley and Vitalik Buterin weigh in on what crypto is actually for.
content: Following the acquittal of the Peraire-Bueno brothers by a judge, industry figures including Bitwise's Hunter Horsley and Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin have shared their perspectives on the practical purpose and utility of cryptocurrency, leaving the broader question open-ended.
content_ta: Peraire-Bueno சகோதரர்கள் நீதிமன்றத்தால் விடுதலை செய்யப்பட்டதை தொடர்ந்து, Bitwise நிறுவனத்தின் Hunter Horsley மற்றும் Ethereum இணை நிறுவனர் Vitalik Buterin உள்ளிட்ட துறை சார்ந்த தலைவர்கள் கிரிப்டோகரன்சியின் உண்மையான நோக்கம் மற்றும் பயன்பாடு குறித்து தங்கள் கருத்துக்களை பகிர்ந்துள்ளனர்.

title: Is MicroStrategy’s 12% Dividend Safe? Its $100 Stock Just Broke Again
summary:
MicroStrategy's 12% dividend stock STRC broke below $100 as Bitcoin dipped under $63,000. Here is where the payout stands.
The post Is MicroStrategy’s 12% Dividend Safe? Its $100 Stock Just Broke Again appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: MicroStrategy's 12% dividend stock, STRC, dropped below $100 as Bitcoin fell under $63,000. Investors are closely watching the safety of the high payout amid the broader cryptocurrency market decline affecting the company's valuation and share price.
content_ta: Bitcoin விலை 63,000 டாலருக்கு கீழே சரிந்ததை அடுத்து, MicroStrategy நிறுவனத்தின் 12 சதவீத டிவிடெண்ட் பங்கு STRC 100 டாலருக்கு கீழே சரிந்துள்ளது. இந்த சரிவு முதலீட்டாளர்கள் மத்தியில் அதன் பேஅவுட் பாதுகாப்பு குறித்த கேள்விகளை எழுப்பியுள்ளது.

title: Nvidia Moves Up Raises and Stock Grants After Jensen Huang Exit
summary:
Nvidia moves staff raises and stock grants to December after Jensen Huang's exit as employees press the board on its CEO search.
The post Nvidia Moves Up Raises and Stock Grants After Jensen Huang Exit appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: Nvidia has advanced its schedule for staff raises and stock grants to December following the departure of CEO Jensen Huang. The decision comes as employees actively press the company's board regarding the ongoing search for a new chief executive officer to lead the tech giant moving forward.
content_ta: CEO Jensen Huang-ன் வெளியேற்றத்தைத் தொடர்ந்து, Nvidia நிறுவனம் தனது ஊழியர்களுக்கான சம்பள உயர்வு மற்றும் பங்கு வழங்கல் கால அட்டவணையை டிசம்பர் மாதத்திற்கு முன்னோக்கி நகர்த்தியுள்ளது. புதிய தலைமைச் நிர்வாக அதிகாரியைத் தேர்ந்தெடுக்கும் பணி குறித்து ஊழியர்கள் வாரியத்தை வலியுறுத்தி வரும் சூழலில் இந்த முடிவு எடுக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: What Is Bitcoin's Power Law and Why Are Analysts Concerned About $62K Support?
summary:
Bitcoin's Power Law support line sits near $62K, says Fidelity's Jurrien Timmer. See why analysts are watching closely.
The post What Is Bitcoin's Power Law and Why Are Analysts Concerned About $62K Support? appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: Fidelity's Jurrien Timmer has highlighted Bitcoin's Power Law support line, which currently sits near the $62,000 price level. Analysts are closely monitoring this key technical threshold to understand the cryptocurrency's potential future price trajectory and market stability.
content_ta: Fidelity-ஐச் சேர்ந்த Jurrien Timmer, Bitcoin-ன் Power Law ஆதரவு கோடு சுமார் $62,000 விலைப் பகுதியில் உள்ளதாகத் தெரிவித்துள்ளார். கிரிப்டோகரன்சியின் எதிர்கால விலை போக்கு மற்றும் சந்தை நிலைத்தன்மையைப் புரிந்துகொள்ள ஆய்வாளர்கள் இந்த முக்கியமான தொழில்நுட்ப எல்லையை உன்னிப்பாகக் கவனித்து வருகின்றனர்.

title: Nvidia’s $500B chip-financing plan stalled, no deals before 2027: WSJ
summary:
Nvidia's stalled financing plan may dampen investor confidence, potentially affecting its stock performance and market valuation outlook.
The post Nvidia’s $500B chip-financing plan stalled, no deals before 2027: WSJ appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Nvidia’s reported $500 billion chip-financing plan has reportedly stalled, with no deals expected before 2027, according to the Wall Street Journal. This delay in the massive financing initiative could dampen investor confidence in the technology sector, potentially impacting Nvidia's stock performance and overall market valuation outlook as market participants reassess their growth expectations for the dominant chipmaker.
content_ta: Wall Street Journal வெளியிட்ட தகவலின்படி, Nvidia நிறுவனத்தின் $500 பில்லியன் சிப்-நிதித் திட்டம் தற்காலிகமாக நிறுத்தப்பட்டுள்ளதாகவும், 2027-க்கு முன்பு எந்த ஒப்பந்தங்களும் இருக்காது என்றும் கூறப்படுகிறது. இந்த பெரிய நிதித் திட்டத்தின் தாமதம் முதலீட்டாளர்களின் நம்பிக்கையைக் குறைக்கக்கூடும், மேலும் இது Nvidia நிறுவனத்தின் பங்குச் சந்தை செயல்திறனையும் சந்தை மதிப்பீட்டையும் பாதிக்கலாம்.

title: OpenAI’s GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol arrive with noticeably different personalities
summary:
The shift towards shorter, more confident responses in GPT-6.2 models may reduce user guidance, impacting decision-making and reliability.
The post OpenAI’s GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol arrive with noticeably different personalities appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: OpenAI has launched its new GPT-6.2 models, named Astra and Sol, featuring noticeably different personalities. The update introduces shorter and more confident responses, which may reduce user guidance and impact decision-making and reliability. The release marks a continued evolution in how AI models interact with their users across various applications.
content_ta: OpenAI தனது புதிய GPT-6.2 மாடல்களான Astra மற்றும் Sol ஆகியவற்றை வெளியிட்டுள்ளது. இவை குறிப்பிடத்தக்க அளவில் மாறுபட்ட ஆளுமைகளைக் கொண்டுள்ளன. இந்த அப்டேட் மூலம் குறுகிய மற்றும் மிகவும் உறுதியான பதில்கள் வழங்கப்படுகின்றன. இது பயனர்களின் வழிகாட்டுதலைக் குறைத்து, முடிவெடுக்கும் திறன் மற்றும் நம்பகத்தன்மையை பாதிக்கக்கூடும்.

title: Trump administration taps TRM Labs in $95 million push to disrupt crypto crime networks
summary:
The initiative could significantly enhance federal capabilities in combating international crypto crime, potentially recovering billions in losses.
The post Trump administration taps TRM Labs in $95 million push to disrupt crypto crime networks appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: The Trump administration has partnered with TRM Labs through a multi-million dollar initiative aimed at disrupting international cryptocurrency crime networks. This effort is expected to significantly enhance federal capabilities in combating digital asset-related offenses and potentially recovering billions in illicit losses.
content_ta: சர்வதேச கிரிப்டோ குற்ற வலைப்பின்னல்களை முறியடிக்கும் நோக்கில் பல மில்லியன் டாலர் மதிப்பிலான திட்டத்தின் கீழ் TRM Labs நிறுவனத்துடன் Trump நிர்வாகம் கூட்டு சேர்ந்துள்ளது. இந்த முயற்சியானது டிஜிட்டல் சொத்து தொடர்பான குற்றங்களை எதிர்த்துப் போராடுவதிலும், சட்டவிரோதமான இழப்புகளை மீட்டெடுப்பதிலும் மத்திய அமைப்புகளின் திறன்களை கணிசமாக மேம்படுத்தும் என்று எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகிறது.

title: BOJ’s Ueda warns rising oil prices, weak yen may hit Japan’s economy
summary:
Japan's economic stability faces challenges as inflationary pressures and currency depreciation may necessitate shifts in monetary policy.
The post BOJ’s Ueda warns rising oil prices, weak yen may hit Japan’s economy appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Bank of Japan Governor Ueda has warned that rising oil prices and a weak yen could negatively impact the Japanese economy. These inflationary pressures and currency challenges may influence future monetary policy decisions as the central bank monitors economic stability closely.
content_ta: Japan's economy பாதிக்கப்படலாம் என்று BOJ தலைவர் Ueda எச்சரித்துள்ளார். உயர்ந்துவரும் எண்ணெய் விலைகள் மற்றும் பலவீனமான yen மதிப்பு ஆகியவை நாட்டின் பொருளாதார ஸ்திரத்தன்மைக்கு சவாலாக இருக்கலாம் என்றும், இது எதிர்கால நாணய கொள்கை முடிவுகளை பாதிக்கலாம் என்றும் அவர் தெரிவித்துள்ளார்.

title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Accounting with plugins for QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite and more
summary:
OpenAI's move into accounting automation could streamline financial operations, but human oversight remains crucial for accuracy.
The post OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Accounting with plugins for QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite and more appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: OpenAI has launched ChatGPT for Accounting, featuring plugins for major platforms like QuickBooks, Xero, and NetSuite. This new tool aims to streamline financial operations and automation. However, industry experts emphasize that human oversight remains crucial to ensure accuracy in accounting tasks. The development highlights the growing integration of artificial intelligence in business software.

title: Ethereum block builders received the most in a $3.4 million vault hack, data shows
summary: An automated trading bot copied the attack on K3 Capital's sBOLD vault, taking more than half the funds and paying most of its proceeds to get its transactions processed first.
content: Ethereum block builders received the majority of funds from a recent $3.4 million vault hack. An automated trading bot copied the exploit targeting K3 Capital's sBOLD vault, capturing over half of the stolen funds. The bot paid massive priority fees to ensure its attacking transactions were processed first, leaving builders with the largest share of the proceeds.
content_ta: சமீபத்தில் நடந்த 3.4 மில்லியன் அமெரிக்க டாலர் மதிப்பிலான vault ஹேக்கில், பெரும்பகுதி தொகை Ethereum block builders-களுக்குச் சென்றுள்ளதாக தரவுகள் காட்டுகின்றன. K3 Capital நிறுவனத்தின் sBOLD vault-ஐ குறிவைத்து நடத்தப்பட்ட இந்தத் தாக்குதலை ஒரு automated trading bot நகலெடுத்துள்ளது. இதன் மூலம் பாதிக்கும் மேற்பட்ட நிதி கைப்பற்றப்பட்டது. தனது பரிவர்த்தனைகள் முதலில் செயல்படுத்தப்படுவதை உறுதி செய்வதற்காக இந்த போட் భారీ priority கட்டணங்களைச் செலுத்தியது, இதனால் builders-கள் மிகப்பெரிய தொகையைப் பெற்றனர்.

summary:
Solana tokenized stock reaches $1.22 billion as Ondo, xStocks and DTCC expand blockchain-based equity infrastructure.
The post Solana Tokenized Stock Hits $1.2B as Wall Street Moves Equities Onchain appeared first on Cryptonews.
content: Solana tokenized stocks have reached $1.22 billion as traditional financial institutions and blockchain projects like Ondo and xStocks expand onchain equity infrastructure. Wall Street continues to move conventional equities onto blockchain networks, driving significant growth in tokenized real-world assets.
content_ta: Solana-ல் டோக்கன் செய்யப்பட்ட பங்குகள் $1.22 பில்லியன் மதிப்பை எட்டியுள்ளன. Ondo மற்றும் xStocks போன்ற பிளாக்சைன் திட்டங்களும் பாரம்பரிய நிதி நிறுவனங்களும் பிளாக்சைன் அடிப்படையிலான ஈக்விட்டி உள்கட்டமைப்பை விரிவுபடுத்துகின்றன. வால் ஸ்ட்ரீட் பாரம்பரிய பங்குகளை பிளாக்சைன் நெட்வொர்க்குகளுக்கு மாற்றி வருவதால், டோக்கன் செய்யப்பட்ட சொத்துக்களின் வளர்ச்சி கணிசமாக உயர்ந்துள்ளது.

title: LIVE – Bitcoin Price, Gold and Oil Fall: Should the US Repeat Its $2.2T 2020 Rescue?
summary:
Bitcoin price, gold and oil fall as hawkish Fed minutes fuel rate hike fears. Should Washington repeat its $2.2T rescue from 2020?
The post LIVE – Bitcoin Price, Gold and Oil Fall: Should the US Repeat Its $2.2T 2020 Rescue? appeared first on Cryptonews.
content: Bitcoin prices, gold, and oil experienced a decline following the release of hawkish Federal Reserve minutes, which heightened fears of upcoming interest rate hikes. This market downturn has sparked discussions among analysts and observers regarding whether Washington should consider repeating its massive $2.2 trillion financial rescue package from 2020 to stabilize the economy.
content_ta: ஹவ்கிஷ் பெடரல் ரிசர்வ் குறிப்புகள் வெளியானதைத் தொடர்ந்து Bitcoin விலைகள், தங்கம் மற்றும் எண்ணெய் விலை சரிவை சந்தித்தன, இது வட்டி விகித உயர்வு குறித்த அச்சங்களை அதிகரித்தது. இந்த சந்தை சரிவு, பொருளாதாரத்தை ஸ்திரப்படுத்த வாஷிங்டன் தனது 2020 ஆம் ஆண்டின் மாபெரும் $2.2 டிரில்லியன் நிதி மீட்புத் திட்டத்தை மீண்டும் செயல்படுத்த வேண்டுமா என்பது குறித்த விவாதங்களை ஏற்படுத்தியுள்ளது.

title: From Bitcoin to AI: A $1.2 Billion Bet That Could Backfire
summary: One question is very interesting: does AI represents a lifeline for struggling Bitcoin miners—or simply a more expensive gamble?
content: Struggling Bitcoin miners are making a massive $1.2 billion bet by shifting their focus toward artificial intelligence. This pivot raises a critical question for the industry: will AI serve as a vital lifeline to rescue their business models, or will it prove to be an even more expensive gamble with high risks of backfiring?
content_ta: போராடி வரும் Bitcoin மைனர்கள், செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவை நோக்கி தங்கள் கவனத்தை மாற்றுவதன் மூலம் 1.2 பில்லியன் டாலர் அளவுக்கு பெரும் முதலீட்டைச் செய்கிறார்கள். இந்த மாற்றம் தொழில்துறைக்கு ஒரு முக்கியமான கேள்வியை எழுப்புகிறது: AI அவர்களின் வணிக மாதிரிகளை மீட்கும் உயிர்நாடியாக மாறுமா, அல்லது அது திரும்பப் பெறக்கூடிய அதிக ஆபத்துள்ள விலையுயர்ந்த சூதாட்டமாக மாறுமா?

title: Bitcoin Staking Could Be Replaced By A New Lending Model — Here’s What It Means For BTC
summary: Bitcoin could be approaching an important turning point in decentralized finance as Babylon, one of the largest Bitcoin staking protocols, considers replacing its existing staking model with a new system built around Bitcoin-backed lending. The development comes as institutional Bitcoin lending continues gaining attention across traditional financial markets. The proposal comes from Babylon co-founder Fisher […]
content: Bitcoin could face a major shift in decentralized finance as Babylon, a leading Bitcoin staking protocol, explores replacing its current staking model with a Bitcoin-backed lending system. This proposed change aligns with growing institutional interest in Bitcoin lending within traditional financial markets.
content_ta: Babylon என்ற முக்கிய Bitcoin staking புரோட்டோகால், தனது தற்போதைய staking மாடலுக்கு பதிலாக Bitcoin-backed lending அமைப்பைக் கொண்டுவருவது குறித்து பரிசீலித்து வருவதால், decentralized finance துறையில் Bitcoin-ல் ஒரு பெரிய மாற்றம் ஏற்பட வாய்ப்புள்ளது. பாரம்பரிய நிதிச் சந்தைகளில் institutional Bitcoin lending மீதான ஆர்வம் அதிகரித்து வரும் காலகட்டத்தில் இந்தத் திட்டம் வந்துள்ளது.

title: XRP Flashes Biggest Volatility Warning Among Major Cryptocurrencies
summary: XRP has flashed the biggest volatility warning among major cryptocurrencies, with Coinbase data showing that options traders are pricing in a seven-day price swing nearly twice as large as its historical median.
content: XRP has triggered the largest volatility warning among major cryptocurrencies. According to Coinbase data, options traders are currently pricing in a seven-day price swing that is nearly twice as large as the asset's historical median, highlighting heightened uncertainty and potential for significant market movement in the near term.
content_ta: പ്രധാന cryptocurrencies-ல் XRP மிகப்பெரிய volatility எச்சரிக்கையைத் தூண்டியுள்ளது. Coinbase தரவுகளின்படி, options வர்த்தகர்கள் ஏழு நாள் விலை மாற்றத்தை அதன் வரலாற்று சராசரியை விட கிட்டத்தட்ட இரு மடங்கு அதிகமாக மதிப்பிடுகின்றனர், இது சந்தையில் அதிகப்படியான நிச்சயதார்த்தத்தைக் காட்டுகிறது.

title: Can AI Hack Smart Contracts? How AI Agents Are Changing Blockchain Security
summary: AI agents can already find and exploit smart contract vulnerabilities in tests, so DeFi teams need stronger defenses.
content: Artificial intelligence agents are increasingly capable of identifying and exploiting smart contract vulnerabilities in testing environments. This technological shift poses new challenges for decentralized finance security. As automated attacks become more sophisticated, DeFi development teams must adopt stronger and more advanced defensive strategies to protect blockchain networks and user assets from potential exploits.
content_ta: செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு முகவர்கள் சோதனை சூழல்களில் ஸ்மார்ட் ஒப்பந்த பலவீனங்களைக் கண்டறிந்து பயன்படுத்துவதில் அதிகளவில் திறன்பட்டு வருகின்றனர். இந்த தொழில்நுட்ப மாற்றம் டெசென்ட்ரலைஸ்டு ஃபைனான்ஸ் பாதுகாப்பிற்கு புதிய சவால்களை ஏற்படுத்துகிறது. தானியங்கு தாக்குதல்கள் மிகவும் சிக்கலானதாக மாறுவதால், பிளாக்செயின் நெட்வொர்க்குகளையும் பயனர் சொத்துகளையும் பாதுகாக்க DeFi மேம்பாட்டுக் குழுக்கள் வலுவான மற்றும் மேம்பட்ட தற்காப்பு உத்திகளைப் பின்பற்ற வேண்டும்.

title: Why Is Alibaba Stock Crashing Before Earnings?
summary:
Alibaba stock has lost 16.9% in five sessions, closing Wednesday at $84.37, its lowest finish since January 2025. A new U.S. chip rule, heavy AI spending, and a fading buyback are hitting the shares hours before earnings. Yet the cloud business is growing 45% a year. Shareholders are paying for that growth in cash, and
The post Why Is Alibaba Stock Crashing Before Earnings? appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: Alibaba stock fell sharply, losing nearly 17 percent over five sessions to reach its lowest finish since January 2025. The decline comes hours before the company's earnings report, driven by a new U.S. chip rule, heavy spending on artificial intelligence, and a slowing buyback program. Despite these pressures and significant cash costs for shareholders, the cloud business continues to show strong annual growth.
content_ta: Alibaba பங்குகள் கடுமையாகச் சரிந்து, ஐந்து அமர்வுகளில் கிட்டத்தட்ட 17 சதவீதம் வீழ்ச்சியடைந்து 2025 ஜனவரிக்குப் பிறகு மிகக் குறைந்த மதிப்பை எட்டியுள்ளன. புதிய U.S. சிப் விதி, அதிகப்படியான செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு செலவினங்கள் மற்றும் மந்தமான பங்கு வாங்குதல் போன்ற காரணங்களால், நிறுவனத்தின் வருவாய் அறிக்கை வெளியாகும் சில மணி நேரங்களுக்கு முன்பு இந்தச் சரிவு ஏற்பட்டுள்ளது. இந்த அழுத்தங்கள் இருந்தபோதிலும், கிளவுட் வணிகம் தொடர்ந்து வலுவான வருடாந்திர வளர்ச்சியைக் காட்டி வருகிறது.

title: Asian Markets Split After Nvidia Rally: Nikkei and KOSPI Rise, Hang Seng Falls
summary:
The post Asian Markets Split After Nvidia Rally: Nikkei and KOSPI Rise, Hang Seng Falls appeared first on Coinpedia Fintech News
Nvidia’s record earnings gave Asia’s chip stocks another boost, but the rally did not reach every market. Japan’s Nikkei and South Korea’s KOSPI index posted strong gains today.  In contrast, Hong Kong’s Hang Seng index fell nearly 2% to hit a four-month low, as China tech stocks faced pressure from U.S. chip restrictions. Japan (Nikkei) …
content: Asian markets showed mixed results following Nvidia's record earnings report. While Japan's Nikkei and South Korea's KOSPI indices posted strong gains driven by a boost in chip stocks, Hong Kong's Hang Seng index dropped nearly two percent to reach a four-month low. This decline was largely attributed to ongoing pressure on Chinese technology stocks resulting from chip restrictions imposed by the United States.
content_ta: Nvidia நிறுவனத்தின் சாதனை வருவாய் அறிக்கையைத் தொடர்ந்து ஆசிய சந்தைகள் கலவையான முடிவுகளைக் காட்டின. சிப் பங்குகளின் எழுச்சியால் ஜப்பானின் Nikkei மற்றும் தென் கொரியாவின் KOSPI குறியீடுகள் வலுவான லாபத்தைப் பதிவு செய்தன, அதே நேரத்தில் ஹொங்கங்கின் Hang Seng குறியீடு கிட்டத்தட்ட இரண்டு சதவீதம் சரிந்து நான்கு மாதக் குறைந்தளவை எட்டியது. சீன தொழில்நுட்ப பங்குகள் அமெரிக்காவின் சிப் கட்டுப்பாடுகள் காரணமாக அழுத்தத்தை எதிர்கொண்டதே இந்த சரித்திற்குக் முக்கிய காரணமாகும்.

title: North Korean hackers used Sky's stablecoin system, putting billions at freeze risk
summary:
The incident highlights vulnerabilities in DeFi systems, potentially prompting increased regulatory scrutiny and impacting institutional trust.
The post North Korean hackers routed Bybit loot through Sky’s stablecoin swap module, report finds appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: North Korean hackers reportedly routed stolen cryptocurrency loot through the stablecoin swap module on Sky, according to a new report. The incident has exposed potential vulnerabilities within decentralized finance systems, raising concerns that billions of dollars could face freeze risks. Industry observers note this event may trigger increased regulatory scrutiny and impact institutional trust in decentralized platforms.
content_ta: North Korean ஹக்கர்கள் Sky நிறுவனத்தின் stablecoin swap module மூலம் திருடப்பட்ட cryptocurrency-ஐ மாற்றியுள்ளதாக புதிய அறிக்கை கூறுகிறது. இந்தச் சம்பவம் decentralized finance அமைப்புகளில் உள்ள பலவீனங்களை வெளிச்சம் போட்டுக் காட்டியுள்ளதுடன், கோடிக்கணக்கான டாலர்கள் முடங்கும் அபாயத்தையும் ஏற்படுத்தியுள்ளது. இந்த நிகழ்வு கடுமையான ஒழுங்குமுறை கண்காணிப்புக்கு வழிவகுக்கும் மற்றும் நிறுவனங்களின் நம்பிக்கையைப் பாதிக்கும் என்று நிபுணர்கள் கருதுகின்றனர்.

content: Bitcoin has moved closer to the $64,000 mark following a record-breaking IPO by Anthropic. title: OmenX announces $2 million in funding from Informed Ventures and launches on-demand 30-second Bitcoin predictions
summary: The Base-native leveraged prediction market platform expands its offering across crypto, global financial assets, sports and esports. Toronto, November 19, 2026 – OmenX, a Base-native leveraged prediction market platform, today announced $2 million in funding from Informed Ventures alongside the launch of its on-demand, 30-second Bitcoin price prediction product. The new product lets users predict whether Bitcoin’s price will rise or fall over the next 30 seconds, with each trade starting its own prediction window. A position opened at 10:00:12 runs until 10:00:42. Users can act when their view forms, with a full 30-second horizon, rather than adapting to the remaining time in a shared market round. Featuring zero-slippage execution and rapid settlement, the product extends the familiar five- and fifteen-minute crypto prediction format to a shorter, individually timed experience. It adds to OmenX’s intraday offering, which spans prediction horizons from 30 seconds to 24 hours, depending on the market. Beyond crypto, OmenX offers directional prediction markets linked to more than 100 global assets, including U.S. equities, futures, ETFs and indices. Its event markets also cover live sports and esports, with sports coverage spanning major football leagues, basketball, American football, ice hockey, baseball and UFC. Leverage has been central to OmenX’s platform from the outset, allowing traders to amplify their exposure on supported event markets. The latest launch builds on that foundation while advancing a broader goal: making prediction markets a practical financial tool for retail users. OmenX organizes the trading decision around a defined question: will an asset’s price be higher or lower at the end of a specified period? Users can express a directional view without purchasing the underlying asset, targeting an exact closing price or constructing an options position that requires decisions about strikes, implied volatility and time decay. “Leverage has been part of OmenX from the start, but our ambition goes beyond adding leverage to prediction markets,” said James, founder and CEO of OmenX. “We want to make global markets easier to participate in. A trader should be able to take a view on Bitcoin, a stock or a sporting event and express it through a clear contract and a timeframe that fits their judgment.” The platform’s emphasis on short, recurring markets provides faster feedback on trading decisions and can reduce the time capital remains committed to individual outcomes. OmenX plans to expand its coverage of traditional and crypto assets while deepening the trading experience across supported markets. About OmenX OmenX is a Base-native leveraged prediction market platform covering crypto, global financial assets, live sports and esports. Through defined outcomes, short settlement cycles and leverage on supported markets, OmenX is building a more accessible way to trade market views. Learn more at omenx.com. Media contact James Zhang Founder at OmenX james@omenx.com
content: OmenX, a Base-native leveraged prediction market platform, has secured $2 million in funding from Informed Ventures. Alongside the funding announcement, the company launched an on-demand, 30-second Bitcoin price prediction product. The platform supports trading across cryptocurrency, global financial assets, sports, and esports, aiming to offer faster settlement cycles and make prediction markets more accessible for retail users.

title: Nomupay Joins AWS ISV Accelerate Program
summary:
Nomupay, the global fintech that offers a unified end-to-end payments platform through a single integration, announced today that it has joined the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Independent Software Vendor (ISV) Accelerate Program, a co-sell program for AWS Partners that provides software solutions that run on or integrate with AWS. The program helps AWS Partners drive new business by directly connecting participating ISVs with the AWS Sales organization.   
The Nomupay platform brings acceptance, payouts, and reporting together via a single platform, providing enterprises with a single integration and contract, rather than a patchwork of providers. The problem that enterprises scaling in APAC and EMEA often face is that every new market brings its own acquirer, integrations, local payment methods, and compliance consideration; and, often, a separate route for paying out partners and suppliers. The result is slower market launches, higher operating overhead, and a compromised checkout experience. 
Nomupay enables enterprises to accept payments locally across Europe and Asia, and access global card processing via Visa, Mastercard, UnionPay, and over 200 local payment methods, including Alipay, WeChat Pay, Google Pay, Apple Pay, and Wero. Merchants can also pay out cross-border in 40+ markets across Europe and Asia, with flexible fund flows and treasury management. Nomupay holds local acquiring licences across Europe and APAC, giving merchants direct market access, reducing reliance on third-party networks. 
Nomupay uses Amazon Bedrock across its payout operations and merchant onboarding, applying generative AI to payment investigations and compliance review with sensitive data redacted, full audit trails and human approval built in. Nomupay is a PCI DSS Level 1 certified service provider, and uses AWS services including Lambda, EMR, API Gateway, AWS ECS, DynamoDB , Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow, AWS RDS, AWS Kinesis and Bedrock. 
Mark Stannard, Chief Business Officer, Nomupay, says, “Every enterprise we speak to wants to grow into new markets without taking on a new payment provider for each one. Working alongside AWS to make Nomupay available in the AWS Marketplace enables enterprises to integrate cross-border payments into their stack as they build their products, rather than bolting it onto their product suite at the end of the build cycle. Nomupay utilises Amazon Bedrock to add generative AI to payment investigations and compliance review, with a human in the loop. We are excited to bring these advanced solutions to merchants via AWS Marketplace"
The AWS ISV Accelerate Program provides Nomupay with co-sell support and benefits to meet customer needs through collaboration with AWS field sellers globally. Co-selling provides better customer outcomes and assures mutual commitment from AWS and its partners.  
AWS ISV Accelerate Program members are held to the industry’s highest standards and must undergo a comprehensive evaluation to gain acceptance into the program. Nomupay participated in a thorough architectural and security review to ensure the quality and design of our solutions. Proof of customer excellence was also reviewed to validate the successes Nomupay customers have achieved across industry verticals.

This collaboration aims to help enterprises scale across Europe and Asia by integrating cross-border payments, payouts, and reporting into a single platform. title: Mastercard and Ant International Advance Trusted Agentic Commerce in Asia Pacific
summary:
Mastercard today announced two milestones that advance trusted agentic commerce in Asia Pacific: a live consumer transaction through Antom, Ant International's merchant payment and digitalization platform, demonstrating how AI agents can act on verified consumer instructions; and a completed Mastercard Agent Pay for Machines (AP4M) pilot with Antom in Singapore, demonstrating how businesses can control and authorize purchases made by their AI agents.
As agentic commerce moves from experimentation toward real-world adoption, AI agents are increasingly positioned to act and transact on behalf of consumers and businesses. Together, Mastercard and Ant International are helping address a critical requirement for this emerging ecosystem: the ability to verify an agent's identity and authority to act. Whether an agent is shopping for a consumer or purchasing services for a business, there needs to be a reliable way to establish who it represents, what it has permission to do and whether it is acting within those parameters.
Proving what a consumer authorized
In the live transaction, an AI agent purchased a cup of coffee based on the consumer's pre-captured intent, with acceptance supported by Antom. The transaction ran on Mastercard Agent Pay with Verifiable Intent, creating a verifiable record of what the consumer had authorized the agent to do.
Mastercard Agent Pay brings together capabilities including network tokenization, authentication and consumer intent to enable secure and trusted agentic payments. As part of this framework, Verifiable Intent is designed as an open, standards-based and protocol-agnostic trust layer that helps merchants and other participants establish trust in agent-initiated transactions by making consumer authorization verifiable.
Extending the same principle to business payments
For businesses, the same challenge takes a different form: how to delegate purchasing authority to an AI agent while maintaining control over what it can buy and how much it can spend. As agents increasingly transact directly with digital services and other machines, payments also need to keep pace with the speed of machine commerce.
 
Introduced in June this year, Mastercard Agent Pay for Machines enables businesses to credential their AI agents, define what those agents are authorized to purchase and spend and enforce those limits at the point of payment. Every transaction leaves an auditable record, and merchants can identify which business an agent represents.
Building on Mastercard's recent live demonstration of AP4M at Cloudflare Connect, the completed pilot in Singapore tested the identity, governance and payment controls businesses need to delegate routine purchasing to agents with confidence. Antom enabled the AI agent to successfully use AP4M's credentialing, policy controls and payment authorization capabilities to purchase digital services within parameters set by the business.
“AI agents are already capable of completing payments. The bigger challenge now is creating the trust for consumers, businesses and merchants to embrace them,” said Joyce Bo, Executive Vice President, Core Payments, Asia Pacific, Mastercard. “Together with Ant International, we’re putting the safeguards needed for agentic commerce into practice across consumer and business payments. By giving people and businesses greater control over what their agents are authorized to do, we can help move agentic commerce from concept to adoption at scale.”
Building trust as agentic commerce scales
Together, the two milestones demonstrate how the same fundamental principles of identity, authorization and accountability apply whether an AI agent is acting for a consumer or a business. Antom brings together consumer payment and merchant acceptance capabilities to help put these principles into practice.
“We’re pleased to work with Mastercard to help merchants succeed in agentic commerce. Our collaboration lets merchants confidently accept purchases from AI agents acting within consumer- or business-approved permissions. That trust creates a foundation for merchants to rethink how they deliver value — from reaching more customers through AI agents to offering services in smaller, flexible units that agents can discover, combine and purchase, opening up new business models. Powered by Ant International's full-stack, AI-native solutions across payments, accounts, FX, treasury and growth operations, we aim to help merchants turn AI capabilities into practical business value — serving customers better, managing operations more efficiently, and preparing for new opportunities as commerce evolves in the agentic era,” said Chunmao Zhu, VP, Technology & Business, Antom.  
Through their work together, Mastercard and Ant International are putting these capabilities into practice while helping advance an open, interoperable approach to agentic commerce as adoption grows.

A live consumer transaction used Antom and Mastercard Agent Pay with Verifiable Intent to show AI agents can act on verified instructions. Additionally, a completed pilot in Singapore tested Agent Pay for Machines, enabling businesses to control and authorize purchases made by their AI agents.

title: Visa Unveils Next Generation of Subscription Management Solutions With Visa Recurrent
summary:
Visa, a world leader in digital payments, today announced Visa Recurrent, a new solution that connects consumers, financial institutions and participating merchants across the recurring payments lifecycle. It enables consumers to view and manage recurring payments through their financial institution’s digital banking experiences, giving them greater visibility and control over recurring payments, at the same time helping financial institutions and merchants deliver more seamless payment experiences.
Visa also announced that Kiwibank is the first issuer globally to deploy Visa Recurrent through its mobile banking app and internet banking, to help give Kiwibank customers a simpler way to understand and manage recurring payments commitments on a channel they already use and trust.
"At Kiwibank, we're always looking for practical ways to make managing money easier,” said Mark Stephen, Chief Customer Officer – Retail at Kiwibank. “We're proud to work with Visa to bring this capability to our Kiwi customers first. It's an exciting milestone and a great example of what can be achieved when organisations work together with a clear focus on customer outcomes.”
Meet Visa Recurrent: More Control, Less Hassle
From streaming and fitness memberships to software and household bills, recurring payments have become a part of everyday life. Yet managing those commitments can still require navigating multiple websites, apps, and customer-service channels. Through participating financial institutions, Visa Recurrent enables consumers to access a consolidated view of eligible recurring payments and take supported actions directly within their digital banking experience.
For participating merchants, Visa Recurrent creates a more connected way to manage customer relationships throughout the recurring payment lifecycle. When consumers take supported actions through their financial institution, merchants may receive timely notifications and use redirects to engage the customer directly.
“Consumers shouldn’t have to hunt across websites, apps and customer service channels just to understand or manage their subscriptions,” said T.R. Ramachandran, Head of Products and Solutions, Asia Pacific, Visa. “Visa Recurrent helps financial institutions bring that visibility and control into the digital banking experiences consumers already use and trust. This makes recurring payments easier to manage while giving banks another way to strengthen their everyday relationship with customers.”
Built for the Way People Pay Today
Consumers increasingly expect simple ways to manage recurring payments, while merchants and financial institutions need clearer signals to manage those relationships efficiently. According to Visa research, one in three New Zealand consumers say they've continued paying for a service they no longer use, and 86% want their bank to provide tools that help them manage recurring payments. Visa Recurrent responds to that demand by enabling participating financial institutions to provide a more connected management experience through their existing digital channels.

title: Update Settlement Infrastructure for New Games, Build a Multi-Rail Trust Layer, and Close the Accessibility Gap in the AI Economy: Ant International’s Peng Yang at SFF 2026
summary:
Speaking at the 2026 Singapore FinTech Festival, Ant International’s CEO Peng Yang argued that our settlement infrastructure needs to evolve beyond today’s four-party payments model to assign effectively roles and responsibilities.
Ant International processed the equivalent of 1.1 trillion USD on its WhaleRTP blockchain settlement network in the last 12 months in collaboration with 23 leading global banks; expected to double in 2027.
He also said that agentic economy needs to rest on a stronger multi-rail, multi-modal and multi-asset trust layer, and that good AI solutions design can power a new, more inclusive globalization project by putting the little guys on a level playing field.

Ant International at the Singapore Fintech Festival 2026
At the Singapore FinTech Festival, Ant International CEO Peng Yang (YP) joined Swift’s Javier Pérez-Tasso and HSBC’s Surendra Rosha for the panel “From Digital to Intelligent: Who Will Build the Next Financial System?”, moderated by Arjun Vir Singh of Arthur D. Little.
YP highlighted three critical angles to tackle the future financial system: 
How should settlement infrastructure evolve in the AI + blockchain era to establish new game rules? 
How to build cross-rail, cross-modal trust for the agentic economy? 
How to mainstream inclusion into AI design to close the accessibility gap for SMEs? 

Peng Yang (R), CEO of Ant International, speaks at the Singapore Fintech Festival 2026.
The Missing Debate: Rewiring settlement infrastructure
The four-party payment model — issuer, acquirer, network, regulator — has served as a mature bedrock for traditional economy. However, would we still need the acquirer or the network as we know it when CBDCs, blockchain and web3 currencies go mainstream? 
Yang argued the industry should brace for new post-4-party models of accountability and new game rules for a world increasingly dominated by account-to-account transactions as merchants begin to run entire transactions on a rail built on tokenization. 
“The settlement layer, the invisible rail—still matters most. Only at this layer can new rules of the game be defined, so everyone plays on the expanded field with clear responsibilities and new boundaries.” 
While pushing the intelligence and application frontiers of AI and blockchain, Ant International felt strongly that its settlement infrastructure needed to evolve, so trust and responsibility can be effectively assigned inside new forms of regulated businesses. 
The shift is already visible. On WhaleRTP, Ant International’s blockchain platform connecting 23 leading global and regional banks, the company settled the equivalent of USD 1.1 trillion in last 12 months. The processing volume is likely to double in 2027.
But the ledger itself is not the challenge. 
“Blockchain is not rocket science,” he said. The hard parts are compliance, the business mechanism, and proving the authenticity of the assets on the rail. To achieve that, banks, fintechs and partners such as Swift need to work together.
The trust layer: no one builds it alone in the multi-rail, multi-modal age
Such foundational technology and institutional changes require a new trust layer. Yang cited a top priority for agentic commerce: KYA – or Know Your Agent. Financial institutions used to run separate, siloed KYC structures. In the KYA era, monitoring and verification happen around the clock across rails and networks. Ant International’s own KYA interoperability framework with Visa and Mastercard is a timely move in that direction. 

Ant International CEO Peng Yang speaks on a panel at Singapore Fintech Festival 2026
The encouraging part, Yang said, is how fast collaboration can move. Ant International proposed the bank-to-wallet direct remit idea to Swift; eight months later it was live, moving funds from a Standard Chartered account to a DANA wallet in seven seconds — a pace that is rare across a field of many private-sector partners.
“We don’t want to do everything ourselves,” Yang said. “Seven years ago nothing existed, so we had to — that’s how Whale was built. Today Swift is building, JP Morgan is building, Citi is building, some countries run fast payment systems, and networks are forming across Southeast Asia.”
In the future, Yang believes there will be an open, connected network where AI picks the best route for each merchant — fastest or cheapest. Builders of the intelligence layer like Ant International would need rails to be open and reliable so each player can use them on behalf of its own clients.
The accessibility gap: if only big tech captures the AI bonus, “that future is boring”
“If technology fast-forwards and only the big enterprises and big tech companies capture the AI premium, that future is boring,” Yang said. Technology has to be democratized so that SMEs and the little guys share in the benefit, not only the largest firms.
Globalization 1.0, while creating unprecedented wealth and prosperity by bringing productivity gains to large enterprises, has left many small businesses, individuals and communities behind, leading to today’s fragmentation. To move the world forward, our re-globalization project has to ensure broader inclusion of the smallest participants. 
From Ant International’s perspective, artificial intelligence – when proactively engineered – will make the task possible. “In our products and solutions design, Ai can narrow the distance between large and small: with agent help, a small enterprise or an individual can compete with the giants.”
From AI breakthroughs to Grassroots Empowerment
In an afternoon session, “Driving Financial Inclusion and Shared Prosperity in an Age of Uncertainty”, Yang recalled a trek through northern Iraq on the Abraham’s Path project, where he and his colleagues saw what connectivity and access to technology, information and choice meant for a remote mountain village. He closed with two ambitions.
“First, payment should be like the internet and email — nobody asks whether an email is domestic or international; the internet killed the concept of a border. Payments still draw a distinct line between local and cross-border. With agentic, with tokenization, with public-private initiatives for interoperability, we should remove those differences — so even the most remote people can enjoy borderless payment, remittance and purchase, online and offline.” YP told fellow panelists, William Ury, Professor at Harvard Law School, Alexandre Chade, Founder & Chairman of Dotz, and Luay Obaidi, and Chief Product Officer, Qi Card.
“Second, if a small player has a big dream, they should be able to access the financial support they need to thrive — with new wallets and financial institutions empowered by technology, that should become the new normal of our economy.”
Singapore Fintech Festival 2026 has seen Ant International rolling out partnerships in the spirit of cross-sector and cross-rail collaboration: 
New developments on trusted agent transactions in agentic commerce with Visa and Mastercard 
Partnership with Singapore's NETS as the first national rail to join Ant International's Agentic Mobile Protocol 
Co-innovation efforts with the Monetary Authority of Singapore as a pioneering partner for its PayNow NQR upgrade with live use cases
Launched the Whale Orchestration Protocol that was developed under the Monetary Authority of Singapore’s (MAS) BLOOM initiative for interoperability between tokenised deposits and tokenised money market funds, as a major upgrade to Ant International’s blockchain-based wholesale settlement platform, WhaleRTP
Alipay+, Ant International’s global wallet gateway that links over 50 global digital wallets and banking apps, is connected to Pix, Brazil's national instant payment system, expanding cross-border digital payment access for international travellers

content: Speaking at the Singapore FinTech Festival 2026, Ant International CEO Peng Yang discussed the future of the financial system in the AI and blockchain era. He highlighted the need to evolve settlement infrastructure beyond traditional payment models, build a multi-rail trust layer for the agentic economy, and close the accessibility gap to empower small and medium enterprises through inclusive AI design and new cross-border partnerships.

title: Why Stable Back-Office SaaS Will Win in the K-Shaped Recovery, Bidding Wars and Exits in 2027
summary:
Over the past few years, I’ve heard many conversations and read articles about the so-called “SaaSpocalypse” - and many who don’t have boots on the ground in the advisory space may believe that due to macroeconomic uncertainties, capital has evaporated from software M&A and the value of software companies will never return to what they used to be.
However, when we observe the market ourselves today, it is nothing like that. In fact, we do not see a dead SaaS investment market. Rather, we see an extreme K-shaped recovery. While average software companies experience long and drawn-out processes with little interest, the very best companies are drawing tremendous levels of interest and competitive bidding – in fact, competitive bidding is at or exceeds levels seen during the best days of the software M&A bull market.
The valuation gap between these best-in-class software companies and the rest of the market is now between $3 and $4 billion. There is a valuation gap between clear leaders in the market and those that do not. Because of these macroeconomic uncertainties, buyer psychology has changed, resulting in a strict and absolute flight to quality. High-value software businesses, based on solid financial metrics and clear structural protection from automating technology, are obtaining higher double-digit annual recurring revenue multiples. Conversely, all other software businesses are settling for reasonable two- to three-times revenue multiples or have had extreme difficulty in transacting.
This dual-track software M&A market is one we have actively navigated. In an environment where software transactions above GBP 200 million face high bars, we witness immense capital interest for top-tier assets. The sale of Origo to iPipeline (Roper Technologies) and BrightAnalytics' majority partnership with PSG Equity highlight key exit options: strategic sales versus sponsor recapitalisations. For founders, a sponsor recapitalisation offers a 'second bite at the apple' by rolling over equity into a growth partnership, though it requires a significant operational shift as founders transition from running an independent company to managing a business with a board-backed growth partner. For those in the top 25% of performers, capital is available, but the bar to reach that level remains at a historical high.
The Mechanics of the Modern Bidding War
The extreme premium currently being paid for the best-in-class software assets is indicative of the amazing imbalance between buyers’ willingness to buy and sellers’ willingness to sell. Strategic buyers with the most cash available on their balance sheets, combined with the global Private Equity industry’s historical record of having $1.2 trillion of dry powder capital waiting to be deployed, have created a flood of long-term demand for top-tier apps but with much higher levels of buyer risk aversion than ever before. No one wants to make a mistake on these types of deals in this extremely volatile environment, so everyone is increasingly drawn to the same small pool of best-in-class assets. This creates an explosive environment for the transaction process. 
We have seen instances of this dynamic already during the launch of Origo; the number of bidders who engaged in the bidding process was 2-3 times what we originally expected because of the scarcity factor at work. Buyers competing aggressively for such assets are effectively insulating them from the volatility inherent in the wider market. However, it will take time and resources to fully extract the potential value of winning these bidding wars. The most significant way to maximise your value is through rigorous examination of the technology’s underlying capabilities. 
Buyers are becoming extremely savvy when making technology acquisitions and have learned to see through the smoke-and-mirrors associated with the descriptions of AI roadmaps and a wrapper around a 3rd-party large language model. These same buyers are looking for real technical defensibility, structural moats, and high workflow gravity in any software they are seeking to acquire. The term “high workflow gravity” refers to software positioning itself at the epicentre of a customer’s daily routine/workflows. 
Therefore, any solution a customer uses with high workflow gravity has created such friction for the customer that it would be virtually impossible to remove the product from their environment. Buyers look for proprietary data routing loops, which are incredibly difficult to replicate with automated code, and for embedded middle-tier infrastructure logic within their technologies, which cannot be easily replicated or commoditised using script-based generative AI models.
The ultimate reason for Origo receiving a price premium was its role as the digital rails for the UK pensions industry. Implementing a unique piece of technology with the operational efficiency and reproducibility of Origo would take decades to replicate. In addition, the adherence to the anticipated use-case data flow has helped in the creation of long-term stickiness, as demonstrated by BrightAnalytics. Their incredible operational stickiness has been derived from the excessive complexity associated with their sophisticated data integrations and reporting. Establishing the above-mentioned technology narratives, and backing them up with objective operational metrics, is the ultimate method to preserving maximum valuation in the sale of technology businesses.
The Blueprint for a 2027 Exit
Continued improvement in the macroeconomic environment will be reflected in an increased number of exits; however, all of the current regulations and policies will remain the same as they have in the past. The previous growth-at-all-costs mentality is no longer viable. A business that achieves a balanced profile based on the Factor of 40, such as 20% growth in sales and a 20% EBITDA, will achieve a much greater premium than a business that is investing in building up its business and spending large amounts of money on chasing raw growth. Buyers now want stable, predictable businesses that can produce a reliable stream of revenue and earnings at a reasonable rate.
If your ultimate goal is to exit your business, you must create your process well in advance and not wait until your process begins to identify the weaknesses within your business.
Assess Technical Resiliency: Conduct an initial technical assessment to identify two or more concrete examples of your data mass, and conduct an independent engineering due diligence to verify them before you proceed to selling.
Establish Core Metrics: Defend your gross and net retention rates (GRR/NRR) and include higher customer switching costs in your product design.
Make the Most of Advisors: Engage corporate finance advisors six to nine months prior to an official launch date, as this affords you plenty of time to establish a rapport with target buyers, assess interest levels in the marketplace, and craft an effective financial story ahead of a formal sale.
It is still possible to achieve premium valuations in the current marketplace; however, institutional investors now require a much higher degree of institutionalisation than ever before in order to invest at this level. While capital exists for these companies, it is essential for the business owner to demonstrate sufficient evidence and support for the position that the business has moved to the right side of the K-Shaped Curve.
Note: All statistics and market data cited are pulled from GP Bullhound’s internal transaction records and proprietary market analysis.

content: Traders are discussing a bizarre pattern linking Bitcoin's upcoming market movements to the highly anticipated release of GTA VI. Commenting on social media, Merlijn The Trader joked about buying the dip instead of purchasing the video game, highlighting a humorous correlation that has caught the attention of cryptocurrency market enthusiasts tracking unusual market indicators.

title: XRP Outperforms Solana and Dogecoin in Japan
summary: XRP ranks next to Bitcoin and Ethereum in the Japanese crypto trading market as the asset accounts for about 15% of the country’s total spot volume.
content: XRP has outperformed both Solana and Dogecoin in Japan, establishing itself as a dominant digital asset in the region. The cryptocurrency currently ranks just behind Bitcoin and Ethereum in the Japanese crypto trading market. According to recent market data, XRP accounts for approximately 15 percent of the country's total spot trading volume, highlighting its strong adoption and popularity among local traders and investors.
content_ta: ஜப்பானில் Solana மற்றும் Dogecoin ஆகியவற்றை விட XRP சிறப்பான வளர்ச்சியைப் பெற்றுள்ளது. பிட்காயின் மற்றும் Ethereum ஆகியவற்றுக்கு அடுத்தபடியாக ஜப்பானிய கிரிப்டோ வர்த்தக சந்தையில் XRP முக்கிய இடத்தைப் பிடித்துள்ளது. நாட்டின் மொத்த ஸ்பாட் வர்த்தக அளவில் சுமார் 15 சதவீதத்தை இந்த சொத்து கொண்டுள்ளது, இது உள்ளூர் வர்த்தகர்கள் மற்றும் முதலீட்டாளர்களிடையே இதன் வலுவான வரவேற்பை வெளிப்படுத்துகிறது.

title: XRP Out at Royal Bank of Canada: Leveraged Fund Cut to Zero

content: Royal Bank of Canada has completely eliminated its exposure to leveraged XRP. According to an amended SEC filing, Canada's largest bank reduced its stake in a 2x XRP exchange-traded fund to zero, reflecting a complete withdrawal of its investment from this specific cryptocurrency fund product.
content_ta: Royal Bank of Canada தனது leveraged XRP முதலீடுகளை முழுமையாக விலக்கிக் கொண்டுள்ளது. திருத்தப்பட்ட SEC ஆவணங்களின்படி, கனடாவின் மிகப்பெரிய வங்கியான இது, 2x XRP ETF-ல் தனது பங்குகளை முழுமையாகக் குறைத்து பூஜ்ஜியமாகக் கொண்டுவந்துள்ளது.

content: Hyperliquid has been added to Hong Kong's suspicious platforms alert list. Despite the regulatory warning, the HYPE token quickly recovered from a brief 5 percent drop, trading near $68.80 less than 24 hours after the announcement as market activity remained resilient.
content_ta: Hong Kong-ன் சந்தேகத்திற்குரிய தளங்களின் எச்சரிக்கை பட்டியலில் Hyperliquid சேர்க்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. இந்த ஒழுங்குமுறை எச்சரிக்கை வந்த போதிலும், HYPE டோக்கன் தனது 5 சதவீத வீழ்ச்சியிலிருந்து விரைவில் மீண்டு, அறிவிப்பு வெளியாகி 24 மணி நேரத்திற்குள் $68.80 அருகில் வர்த்தகமானது.

title: Lithuanian SME bank modernises core with SaaScada ahead of European expansion
summary:
Cloud-native core banking provider, SaaScada, announced today that SME Bank has gone live using SaaScada’s data-driven core banking platform, powering the European neobank’s next phase of international growth.  
Headquartered in Lithuania, SME Bank has successfully launched its current accounts, payments, debit cards and savings products for small- and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) on SaaScada’s cloud-native core banking engine. The modernised core will give SME Bank the scalability, flexibility and speed needed to expand beyond the Baltics, starting with the Netherlands, and launch tailored SME products across new markets faster. 
SME Bank’s core banking modernisation comes as the neobank enters a period of rapid growth. In 2025, SME Bank nearly doubled its loan portfolio to €148m, increased customer deposits from €170m to €428m, and grew interest income by 35% to €14.6m. 
SaaScada will support SME Bank by providing the neobank a modern core banking platform built for faster product development, international expansion and real-time customer insight. Key benefits include: 
Unlocking new revenue streams – SaaScada’s event-driven architecture gives SME Bank a real-time view of activity across customer accounts. This granular behavioural insight allows SME Bank to dynamically tailor products and rapidly bring high-value services to market, such as personalised lending solutions.
Accelerating time to market, with no downtime – SaaScada’s flexible, no-code configuration enables product teams to launch and refine offerings, eliminating developer bottlenecks, slow vendor module integrations and planned release downtime. SME Bank retains full autonomy over its product launch cadence and continuous feature rollouts.
Simplifying multi-country expansion – SaaScada’s data-driven core gives SME Bank the flexibility to enter new jurisdictions without rebuilding its core infrastructure for each market. The platform enables SME Bank to serve multiple jurisdictions from a single core, keeping each market’s data separate, while maintaining clear oversight across its wider operations.
Reducing regulatory friction - SaaScada is supplying SME Bank with a proven foundation for EU expansion under the Bank of Lithuania and European Central Bank frameworks. SaaScada’s single instance, multi-entity architecture ensures strict jurisdiction-level data segregation and automated regulatory reporting, while its real-time ledger natively satisfies SEPA Instant Payments requirements by guaranteeing fund availability within 10 seconds. 
Lukas Baškys, CEO of SME Bank, commented: “Partnering with SaaScada marks an important step in our European growth strategy. As we scale, our focus remains on what matters to SMEs: straightforward banking, responsive service and financial products that meet their needs. SaaScada gives us a stronger foundation to bring new services to market faster and adapt them to local needs, while maintaining consistent service as we grow. This investment supports our ambition to become a long-term banking partner for more SMEs across Europe. ”
Tomas Smalakys, CIO at SME Bank, comments: “Modern banking is increasingly data-driven, and the core technology behind our products needs to support that shift. As we expand across Europe, we need a platform that is not only flexible, but also easy to govern. SaaScada gives us real-time data, strong territory-level control and the ability to adapt to regulatory requirements without unnecessary complexity. It also gives us greater flexibility and control over product development, helping us launch and adapt products faster, use customer insight more effectively, and deliver change without the long lead times often associated with legacy core banking systems.” 
“We’re delighted to be working with SME Bank, a recognised innovator in Lithuania and one of our flagship customers in the region,” said Nelson Wootton, CEO and Co-Founder of SaaScada. “By bringing together SME Bank’s local market knowledge of Lithuania and the Baltics with our ability to provide immediate insights and the freedom to act on them fast, we have a combination of expertise and capabilities that drive innovation and growth. We’re excited to support SME Bank as it expands its offerings and grows beyond its local region.”

The partnership enables SME Bank to launch current accounts, payments, debit cards, and savings products for small- and medium-sized enterprises. SaaScada's platform provides real-time data insights, multi-country scalability, and regulatory compliance under European frameworks, supporting the neobank's continued international growth.

title: BPC and Huawei Launch Solution Partnership to Accelerate Digital Payments Modernisation
summary:
Huawei Technologies and BPC have launched a solution partnership at the Singapore FinTech Festival 2026 to accelerate digital payments  modernisation and expand integrated payment solutions for financial institutions across Asia  Pacific, the Middle East and Africa, Latin America and selected international markets. 
The partnership brings together BPC's modern SmartVista digital payments platform with  Huawei's cloud, computing and infrastructure technologies to create an integrated  technology proposition for financial institutions. SmartVista offers capabilities across Issuing,  Acquiring, Digital Ecosystems and Enterprise Fraud, supporting financial institutions in  enabling, processing and managing a broad range of digital payment services. 
By combining SmartVista with Huawei's Digital Cloud Solution, Huawei Cloud Stack and  Kunpeng computing platforms, both organisations will work towards developing an  integrated, pre-tested and certified technology architecture. Huawei's established System  Integrator network, together with BPC's existing partner ecosystem, will support joint  customer engagement, solution delivery, implementation and integration. 
For financial institutions, the collaboration aims to provide a modern, scalable and resilient  technology proposition for payment infrastructure modernisation. By reducing the complexity  traditionally associated with designing, integrating and validating multiple technology  components independently, the joint proposition is intended to help customers accelerate  deployment and respond more effectively to changing consumer expectations and evolving  payment requirements. 
ZX LI, Chief Alliance Officer, Huawei Technologies, commented: “We are delighted to  announce this solution partnership with BPC. Combining BPC’s leading digital payments  capabilities with Huawei’s full-stack cloud and Kunpeng computing platforms allows us to  deliver pre-integrated, high-performance joint solutions that reduce deployment complexity.  Together, we are committed to helping financial institutions build future-ready payment  infrastructures and drive inclusive digital finance.” 
Jonathan Lee, Partnership Manager APAC, BPC, commented: “Our partnership with Huawei  represents an important milestone in expanding our technology and business ecosystem. By  combining SmartVista's next-generation digital payments capabilities with Huawei's cloud  and computing technologies, we aim to deliver a comprehensive, end-to-end proposition that  helps financial institutions modernise their payment capabilities and accelerate innovation  across APAC, MEA, LATAM and beyond.” 
The partnership establishes a framework for long-term cooperation spanning technology  onboarding, integration and certification, joint solution development, innovation, solution  delivery and commercial development. BPC and Huawei will work together to advance the  joint proposition and expand its reach across APAC, MEA, LATAM and selected  international markets.

title: Unzer and i80 Group Partner to Accelerate Buy Now, Pay Later Growth With Up to €200 Million in Financing
summary:
Unzer, a leading European payment company, and investment firm i80 Group have agreed on a receivables financing facility of up to €200 million to support further growth of Unzer's Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) business. The facility will fund Unzer's invoice and instalment payment solutions to support growing merchant and customer demand.
The partnership comes as Unzer reports strong demand for its BNPL services. The number of merchants actively using these services has increased by around 50% compared with the same period last year, according to Unzer.
Invoice payments remain particularly popular in Germany. According to the EHI Retail Institute, purchase on invoice was the country's second-largest online payment method in 2025, accounting for more than 25% of online sales. For merchants, offering customers their preferred way to pay makes it easier to complete purchases and can help increase sales.
“Our BNPL business has grown strongly this year, and we want to keep that momentum going,” says Dr. Götz Möller, CFO of Unzer. “But growth also means you need the right financing behind you. That's why we're really pleased to have i80 as a strong financing partner on board. Given their substantial experience in this area as well as the excellent collaboration, we can bring our BNPL solutions to even more merchants.”
“Unzer has built a scaled BNPL business with deep merchant relationships across the DACH region and a disciplined, data-driven approach to underwriting,” says Jomart Tleujan, Investment Director at i80 Group. “We worked closely with the Unzer team to design a bespoke facility that scales sustainably with their BNPL volumes. The transaction reflects i80 Group’s focus on providing flexible, privately structured asset-based financing to established platform lenders and we look forward to supporting Unzer’s next phase of growth.”
Hogan Lovells Cadwalader acted as transaction counsel for the agreements, Alvarez & Marsal acted as advisor to Unzer. Credibur was appointed as calculation and verification agent and back-up servicer. Circumference acts as cash manager and corporate services provider for the underlying Special Purpose Vehicle.

The partnership highlights the strong performance and continued expansion of Unzer's payment services across its key operating markets.

title: $658bn Lost to Money Laundering in the US Last Year as Canada Climbs to Second in Global AML Index
summary:
An estimated $658.43bn was lost to money laundering in the US last year, equivalent to 2.14% of the country's GDP, according to Napier AI. The US ranked 16th out of 42 markets assessed, while its northern neighbor Canada climbed to second, highlighting the continued scale of illicit finance moving through the American economy.
Despite maintaining one of the strongest AML effectiveness scores globally for three consecutive years, the US continues to spend an estimated $59.91bn on anti-money laundering (AML) compliance, yet remains the second-largest contributor to illicit flows of all 42 markets assessed, with only China reporting higher total money laundering losses.
The findings come from the Napier AI / AML Index 2026 – 2027, in partnership with GlobalData.
Canada, which shares the world's longest land border with the US, rose from eighth to second on the Index this year, with money laundering losses falling from 3.16% of GDP in 2024 to 2.75% in 2025. But its position next to the country that has historically set the global sanctions agenda carries its own costs, with Canada's compliance costs relative to its losses creeping up.
The Index's new border line of financial crime analysis, which examines how geographic and political proximity to sanctioned nations shapes money laundering risk, identifies a paradox in the US. The country shows the sharpest political disagreement of any market studied with the countries it sanctions, yet its compliance spend is comparatively light when set against its own money laundering losses.
Greg Watson, CEO of Napier AI, commented: “The scale of money laundering remains staggering even with promising signs of pushback in the fight against financial crime. For too long it has been assumed that the rising cost of financial crime was an inevitability, but our research proves otherwise. 
However, conflicts and rapidly changing sanctions regimes have resulted in an uneven regulatory environment and gaps in financial crime defenses which criminals exploit. Our newest analysis traces these trends that create the border line of financial crime and outlines how geographic and political proximity impact risk exposure as much as domestic defenses and regulatory red tape. So, despite the headline progress made, nations cannot afford complacency. Financial crime moves as fast, so AML must innovate faster.”
Dr. Janet Bastiman, Chief Data Scientist at Napier AI, commented: “Over $3 trillion in AML recovery offers huge potential for economies and organisations, and our data shows that spending more on compliance isn’t the only answer. Better detection and underlying data, underpinned by AI, gives compliance teams a more accurate picture of their financial risk and allowing them to focus on the largest money laundering threats.
But that AI must be explainable and every automated decision must be auditable by a regulator. It requires human judgement to both own the decisions and also understand the patterns that criminals are using to stop illicit flows.” 
The Index also reports a fall in the cost of AML compliance for the US, decreasing 10.2% from $66.74bn in 2024 to $59.91bn in 2025. Across the Americas, the US accounts for roughly six in every seven dollars spent on financial crime compliance, reflecting its economic scale rather than markedly higher risk.

Meanwhile, Canada climbed to second place globally on the AML Index, reflecting ongoing regional challenges with illicit finance. title: Zopa Calls on Brits to ‘January-Proof’ Christmas With AI as Customers Get Chance to Win £10,000
summary:
Zopa, the British digital bank pioneer with 2 million customers, is calling on Brits to ‘January-proof’ their Christmas by embracing a responsible and personalised approach to festive spending using AI. 
Part of Zopa’s award-winning Biscuit current account, “Ask Zopa” is designed to help millions of Brits manage their money simply by asking. 
Customers can use it to plan upcoming spending, understand their finances, split bills, set savings goals and complete everyday banking tasks – making it particularly useful at Christmas, when plans and spending can change quickly.
That could mean creating a Christmas spending pot with a fixed amount inside, setting real time spending alerts to stay on budget, or simply understanding what expenses are coming up and asking Zopa to help plan for the longer stretch into January.
Taking the guesswork out of gifting
This festive season Zopa is also introducing a new AI-powered wish list generator that helps take the guesswork out of your Christmas list. 
Available simply by asking, the tool suggests personalised gift ideas based on a customer’s unique transaction history. Customers can then refine the suggestions through conversation, before sharing items from the finished list with friends and family so that gifting cash is well spent.
The feature makes Zopa the first UK bank to offer AI-powered Christmas gift recommendations.
The five long weeks of Christmas
With festive spending starting early and December salaries needing to stretch further, the Christmas AI features launch as new Zopa research* reveals the importance of seasonal budgeting. 
Nearly half (43%) of UK workers will be facing a wait of five weeks or more between their December and January paydays, compared with just 6% during a typical pay cycle.
Among those facing a five-week or longer wait, the average customer spends 70% of their December pay before January’s salary arrives. For those waiting six weeks or more, this rises to 90%.
But the pressure on festive finances starts well before December payday.
Retail spending rises by 37% in December compared with a typical month, while spending on groceries and going out increases by 23% and 19% respectively, putting further pressure on household budgets.
The Christmas shopping rush peaks around Black Friday and Cyber Monday, with retail spending on Cyber Monday last year reaching 2.1 times that of a normal Monday, meaning Christmas shopping is already well underway before December even begins.
Winning back the cost of Christmas
Alongside its new smart tools for budgeting and Christmas gifting, Zopa is now also giving its Biscuit current account customers the chance to win back the cost of Christmas.
New and existing Biscuit customers who make at least five transactions by 4 January 2027 will have the chance to win the £10,000 top prize, with a further 15 customers winning up to £2,000 each. Winners will be announced on 18 January 2027.
Clare Gambardella, Chief Customer Officer at Zopa Bank, said: “Christmas spending often starts weeks before December payday, and that salary then has to stretch across a much longer wait until January. That’s why we’re encouraging consumers to ‘January-proof’ their Christmas now, by planning for the entire festive period.
“Zopa Bank always aims to offer ease and value to customers and with Ask Zopa, customers can simply talk through their plans, get help managing their money and take budgeting actions, all in one place, without needing spreadsheets or complicated trackers."
Zopa launched its Biscuit current account in 2025, quickly establishing it as the UK’s best current account for everyday value, rated #1 by MoneySavingExpert for cashback, perks and regular savings.
Drawing on the different ways customers manage their everyday finances, Zopa’s Biscuit has now evolved into one of the UK’s most customisable current accounts, giving customers the flexibility to choose the benefits that suit them best and switch them as their priorities change. 
In addition to:
A 1% AER variable on all balances 
One free coffee per month 
Fee-free card spending abroad 
Access to the UK's most advanced banking AI
Customers can choose between:
3% AER variable interest on their balance OR
3% cashback on up to £150 of eating-out spend each month OR
3% cashback on up to £150 of Direct Debits each month
Zopa was voted the UK’s Best App for 2026 at the British Banks Awards. 
One of the UK’s highest-rated and most celebrated financial brands, it has won more than 10 British Bank Awards, holds a 4.6/5 rating on Trustpilot, and consistently receives among the highest customer satisfaction scores in the industry.
